text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You didn't run away after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, I just wanted to confirm whether you'd truly turned into a complete coward. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for being so honest and direct with your feelings."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because King laid her true feelings bare, I was able to speak mine right out. And then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Not only do I feel refreshed,
I just came up with a greaaat plan! ☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky-san...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So, thanks a bunch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: King's absolute, ultra-favorite strategist Sei-chan is back in action☆ Aren't you thrilled?☆

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...!
I never said I loved you, though!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? Sounded to Sei-chan like you were
screaming it with all your might, though?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So basically, I'm totally pumped up
and full of energy right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to this "first-rate running" of yours.
Let's have a good race—rival.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Keep me on the edge of my seat on the final stretch, okay?
Not that I have any intention of letting you pass me~."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Geez.
You're getting way ahead of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan!
I've been looking forward to today so much!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, not really my thing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh~ !?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~.
Up until yesterday, that is.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right now—Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat you.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm glad. Because this is the first time I've ever heard a 'declaration of war' from you, Sei-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, I won't let you go on a journey alone!
I won't—let you get away!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, maybe I'll make suuuure
to run away with the lead all the way♪
